shows: An organization that has spent its tier's monthly cap gets 429 rate_limit_error with details.error_code enforced_spend_limit_reached and no retry-after, until the next month.

error.message: You have reached your API usage limits: your organization has crossed its monthly API usage threshold, set based on your organization's API tier. You will regain access on 2026-12-01 at 00:00 UTC.
